name: Cognitive Maze v2.0.1 - Robust Cloud Sync, Alias Purging & Background Loading
notes: Version 2.0.1 — Maintenance & Resilience Update: Resolves ghost grade synchronization by thoroughly purging all student identifier aliases across local caches and cloud records; introduces non-blocking background cloud synchronization on student selection for zero UI stutter; adds safeguard to prevent headless automated test suites from writing dummy scores to live cloud database; ensures recorded completion dates persist reliably across quarters.
